title: When the Sequence Resets

launchpad.outcome: Reassess the active PIL when new relevant structure forms, instead of waiting forever on an old setup.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Keep waiting for the old PIL, or reassess?

slides.headline: PIL A · I ✓ C ✓ C ✓ · no retest

slides.heading: A new swing means: reassess

beats.title: Keep the current PIL
beats.line: If the new swing doesn’t change what matters.

beats.title: Reassess the PIL
beats.line: If a newer reference now controls the move.

beats.title: Mark the setup replaced
beats.line: If a newer sequence took over.

slides.punch: Not “a new swing always means cancel”.

slides.quote: Don’t wait forever for an old setup while price builds a new one in front of you.

slides.prompt: What should you do when a new relevant swing forms during a setup?
slides.modelAnswer: Reassess the current structure and PIL. Sometimes I keep it, sometimes the new swing becomes the reference, sometimes the old setup is replaced.

remember: Don’t wait forever for an old setup.
